cnpjs.title: CNPJs
cnpjs.description: List of CNPJs (14 digits, with or without punctuation). Invalid CNPJs are reported but never charged. / Lista de CNPJs, com ou sem pontuação.

includePartners.title: Include partners (QSA)
includePartners.description: Include the list of partners/shareholders published by Receita Federal. / Incluir quadro de sócios.

monitorChanges.title: Monitor changes between runs
monitorChanges.description: Remember each company in a key-value store of your account and add a 'changes' field listing what changed since the previous run (status, address, partners, activities...). Ideal for scheduled runs. / Compara com a execução anterior.

onlyChanged.title: Output only changed companies
onlyChanged.description: With monitoring on, only companies that changed (or are new) are written and charged.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel lookups. Public sources rate-limit, so keep it low.
